title: Access chronicle ledger and automated provisioning hygiene for compliance
creator: Jordan Li
description: Summary: Build an immutable, region-aware "chronicle ledger" of account and role provisioning events plus an automated provisioning-hygiene pipeline to reduce orphaned privileges and produce audit-ready reports. Background: Current access evidence is assembled from ad-hoc exports and periodic SCIM reconciles; auditors want continuous, queryable provenance with retention enforcement by residency. Goal: produce a daily snapshot and on-demand report that ties SSO/SAML assertions, SCIM change events, and RBAC policy deltas to a single canonical event stream; implement automated remediation flags and a JIT revocation playbook for expired/unused rights. Scope: ingest SAML login assertions, SCIM delta webhook stream, RBAC policy changes from the policy service, and service-account key events. Persist an encrypted event ledger partitioned by customer residency (region tag) and retention TTL. Provide an API and Console view for reviewers to run periodic access reviews and export signed evidence bundles. Success metrics: reduce orphaned privileged principals by 75% within 6 weeks of rollout; provide auditors with a single report generation flow that returns a residency-scoped evidence bundle under 15 minutes for standard queries; daily cron job produces snapshot with no more than 2% missing records. Acceptance criteria: 1) Event ingestion pipeline proves end-to-end for SAML, SCIM, and RBAC sources in a staging tenant. 2) Ledger stores region tag and retention metadata on each event. 3) Console shows a reconciled view with reason codes and remediation suggestions. 4) Automated hygiene job identifies and flags accounts meeting 'unused for 90+ days + privileged' policy and can optionally create a JIT revocation ticket. 5) Signed evidence bundle (ZIP) can be exported with cryptographic signature and includes retention provenance manifest. Out of scope: full automated role removal without explicit reviewer approval; integration with third-party entitlement management beyond SCIM.
technical_approach: SCIM change stream consumer: push events into Kinesis and normalizer lambda to canonical event schema
SAML assertion hook: capture login assertion metadata (idp, session timestamps, attributes) and attach to user identity in ledger
RBAC delta capture: instrument policy service to emit policy-change events with before/after snapshots
Event ledger: append-only, encrypted objects stored in region-tagged buckets (S3/GCS) with object-level retention metadata
Retention enforcement: lifecycle controller enforces TTLs and moves expired objects to long-term archive before legal purge windows
Hygiene pipeline: daily reconcile job compares current RBAC grants to usage and flags stale or orphaned grants; creates recommended remediation items
Evidence bundle generator: queryable API that assembles events, signs bundle with KMS key, and produces residency-scoped ZIP for auditors
Console UX: reviewer table with filters (region, role, last-used, owner) and bulk actions to create JIT revocation tickets
Permissions: new internal service account for ledger-writer with scoped KMS keys and strict IAM roles
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: High cardinality event stream could increase storage/costs. Mitigation: compress events, batch writes, and configurable retention per-customer.
Risk: SCIM drift may produce false positives. Mitigation: implement heuristic window and require repeated flags before auto-action; surface raw SCIM deltas in reviewer UI.
Risk: Cross-region data residency complexity. Mitigation: store events only in customer-designated regions and restrict console exports to region-aware endpoints.
Risk: KMS key sprawl and complexity. Mitigation: use a single account-scoped KMS key hierarchy with clear rotation policy and audit logs.
Risk: False revocations impacting production. Mitigation: default to flagging + reviewer approval; provide playbook for emergency rollback and allow immediate unflagging.
Risk: Performance impact on policy service. Mitigation: use async emission and backpressure queueing; instrument with SLOs and rate limits.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 - Staging (2 weeks): wire SCIM and SAML test tenants; validate ledger schema; exercise evidence export; manual review flows
Phase 2 - Canary (2 weeks): enable for 5 pilot customers with varying residency requirements; monitor costs and reconciler precision
Phase 3 - Gradual (4 weeks): expose console features to all customers behind feature flag; enable daily hygiene flags but keep auto-remediation off
Phase 4 - Opt-in Automation (after review): allow customers to opt-in to auto-remediation with configurable policy thresholds
Post-rollout: run a retrospective and auditor walkthrough; prepare compliance package for SOC/ISO evidence reviewers
testing_plan: Unit tests for normalizer and schema validations
Integration tests covering SCIM delta -> ledger append -> evidence generation
Chaos test: simulate missed SCIM webhook window and validate reconciliation correctness
Performance test: ingestion pipeline at 10x expected peak (including burst from SCIM bulk syncs)
Security test: KMS key rotation simulation and signed bundle verification
notes: Suggested RBAC policy for hygiene flags: roles with scope 'admin:*' and last_used > 90d
This ticket should coordinate with ENG-4217 for enterprise access-control hooks
